objective: Repair and independently review one frozen successor proposal without experiment execution.

candidates.title: Versioned probabilistic-propagation successor repair
candidates.uncertainty: Whether all BATCH-3033bc blocking cost, probability, inference, control, ceiling, novelty, and budget defects can be repaired in a falsifiable proposal that is fit for a later experiment-design decision.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a PASS-reviewed proposal and name a separately authorized future experiment-design action; this batch still executes nothing.
candidates.negative_decision: Record REJECT or a scoped obstruction with the exact failed obligation; no mathematical negative about ECDLP follows.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Record REVISE and the cheapest remaining repair or falsification control; no experiment is admitted.
candidates.next_action: Freeze the opening, author the versioned proposal, freeze it, and obtain an independent adversarial review.

ambiguities.question: Does a proposal-level PASS authorize execution?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It authorizes at most a separately opened and reviewed experiment-design task.
ambiguities.basis: BATCH-3033bc restart condition and this batch claim ceiling.

candidates.dominated_by: Pollard rho and BSGS remain the matched baselines; no Pareto improvement exists unless the repaired proposal establishes its fully charged decision gate.

sota_delta.note: Proposal and review only; no algorithmic improvement is measured or claimed.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Immutable successor proposal plus a fresh independent review-adversarial verdict bound to that snapshot.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: REVISE preserves the proposal at unverified status and names one bounded successor action.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any missing charge, quantifier, Boolean-success bridge, clustered-inference rule, executable control, ceiling, novelty check, or resource calculation is REVISE rather than inferred PASS.
peripheral_exclusions: Any hypothesis or research-question status change
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: The independent review and Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Native Idea Generator and independent adversarial review inference time; no curve computation.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Design work is bounded by corpus review and symbolic cost/probability auditing, not by ECDLP instance size.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One active candidate and one role at a time; archival tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one proposal, one independent verdict, and one ledger disposition, or immediately on an archive-integrity failure.
